qtitle: Direct international flights from Patna airport
name: Bhim Singh
qn_text: (a) whether it is a fact that Patna airport is named as “Jai Prakash Narayan International Airport” while there are no direct international flights operational from here; (b) whether such situation is unfavourable and economically disadvantageous for a State like Bihar with such a high population density and migrant workforce; and (c) whether Government is making any concrete plans to start direct international flights to Gulf countries and South-East Asia etc., if so, the status and the probable timeline thereof?
